newsitem.title: UK: Lehman sells 11.7 million shares in Acorn.
newsitem.headline: Lehman sells 11.7 million shares in Acorn.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Wednesday it had sold 11.7 million shares in Acorn Computer Group Plc.
It said the shares were the remainder of the 14.7 percent stake it bought from Olivetti Telemedia Investmemts BV on June 28.
Lehman said in July it had hedged its position on Acorn via a derivative contract with Olivetti and it also said at the time that it intended to sell the stake on to investors.
Lehman did not disclose price details nor to whom the stake was sold but added that, following the sale of the stake, its derivative contract with Olivetti would end.
Acorn shares closed 10p higher in London at 192-1/2p with 23 million shares traded.
